title: security verify: make portal DB-backed integration tests runnable
description: The audit could not fully verify portal BFF/control-plane auth, RBAC, tenant isolation, settings, projects, session sharing, staging, and vault integration tests because CONTROL_PLANE_DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_URL was not configured. Add a documented local/CI Postgres test path, preferably one command that starts or points to a disposable database and runs the affected suites.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Developer can run the control-plane integration suite locally with one documented command.
- [ ] Developer can run the BFF integration suite locally with the same or clearly paired database setup.
- [ ] The setup is isolated and idempotent, with cleanup guidance for local runs.
- [ ] Verification includes control-plane auth/RBAC/tenant-authz tests and BFF auth/settings/vault/project/session-share tests.
- [ ] The final audit follow-up records pass/fail counts after the DB-backed suite runs.
notes:
Implemented one-command DB-backed integration runner. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/138 commit 2d9e357. Evidence: artifacts/security/lp-p37.2-db-backed-integration.md — CP 7 files/52 tests pass; BFF 9 files/39 tests pass; overall PASS (security-focus). Disposable mode verified.
SHIP: PR #138 marked ready (not draft). auto_merge=false — left open. Review approved. CI path-detect fail is org billing/infra (not product). https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/138
